neighbours.label: punctuation or a word just before a warning or a bad outcome (guess)
fire: Beware of sites that promise easy money. If one asks for your bank details, leave.
The clinic prescribed strong pills for a sore throat, and as a result she died.
Do not trust callers who offer free prizes. If they ask for a fee, hang up.
They gave the boy too much medicine, and in the end he was badly hurt.
Avoid dealers who sell cheap watches. If the price seems too low, walk away.
The driver ignored the storm warning, and as a result two people drowned.
Stay away from offers of free work from home. If they want a deposit, refuse.
The firm skipped the safety checks, and sadly a worker lost his arm.
quiet: Look at sites that review good books. If one has a newsletter, join.
The clinic prescribed mild drops for a sore eye, and soon she felt fine.
Do say hello to callers who ask for the manager. If they wait, smile.
They gave the boy a small gift, and in the end he was very happy.
Visit dealers who sell nice watches. If the shop is open, go inside.
The driver checked the weather report, and then two people got in.
Read about offers of paid work from home. If they suit you, apply.
The firm passed the safety checks, and later a worker got a raise.

short: before a warning or bad outcome (guess)
